slides: Your muscles remember the last load you gave them.
If you repeat the same weight, they stop adapting.
Add just one extra rep or a few pounds each week.
The nervous system sees it as a new challenge.
Small increments compound into lasting strength.
Decision fatigue is the silent thief of willpower.
Every trivial choice drains mental bandwidth.
Bundle low-effort habits into a single routine.
Your brain treats the bundle as one decision.
Free up energy for the choices that truly matter.
Recovery starts the moment you close your eyes.
Deep sleep releases growth hormone and clears metabolites.
Consistent 7-9 hours stabilizes cortisol.
Better sleep = stronger immune response and muscle repair.
Prioritize rest like you prioritize reps.
Your future self is a mirror of today's actions.
Identity is built by repeated proof points.
Ask: does this task reinforce the person I want to be?
If yes, do it; if no, let it go.
Live now as the version you'll thank tomorrow.
